notes: Retest mode: ran the full backend pytest suite first (18 passed, 2 new files added), then re-ran all pre-existing named browser checks by name only, per instructions.

Two new backend test files close gaps this iteration's briefing raised: (1) test_tscheck_attempts_series_and_grading_shape.py for the evaluate_conversation(EvalRequest) full scorecard shape and the attempt_series (_attempt/_apply_totals/_apply_category_movement) first/latest/best/delta/category_deltas/most_improved/still_weakest fields; (2) test_tscheck_retry_moment_active_sim_conflict.py for the 409-on-active-simulation branch of the retry_moment split not previously covered.

Three new browser checks close UI-facing gaps: coaching-report-full-render (strengths-list/strength-* cards, retry-moment-* buttons, banner reachability), business-objection-suggestions-memo (memoised suggestion-chip add/remove on the multi-step /practice-business/setup wizard), skill-module-prepare-remember-list (prepare-remember list on /learn/:exerciseId via the module-skip-to-call shortcut).

Non-obvious findings while writing these (not bugs, just app wiring worth noting): 'category_scores' in the evaluation is a list of {category,score,note}, not a dict; /business is not a real route (actual path is /practice-business/setup); the setup wizard's Next button briefly disables while autosaving between steps, so rapid unwaited clicks silently no-op — checks now wait for the button to re-enable between steps; jumping straight to the Pre-call prep step is done via the module-skip-to-call button rather than the step-nav pill.

spec_deviations from the briefing (un-split SkillModule/BusinessSetup/Team, decorative index keys, bearer token in localStorage, anonymous 401 on /api/auth/me) remain accepted as intentional, not flagged as bugs.
Console noise across all checks was limited to the expected anonymous 401 probe on GET /api/auth/me and the expected 409s from the intentional double-click/concurrency hard-stop tests.
